backend/main.mo: Main backend canister defining authorization mixins, admin password logic, user profile types, and maps for schedules, filters, activities, locations, audit logs, and account state.
feature_evidence.json: List of implemented i18n-related features with associated files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend components, pages, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base and theme variable definitions for light/dark modes using custom HSL tokens.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that loads the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app handling authentication, role-based routing, i18n, theming, and landing page rendering.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccountsTa: Admin table component for viewing users, showing roles, and enabling/disabling accounts with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPassw: Provides UI to verify or change the admin password, handling validation, error states, and gate access.
frontend/src/components/admin/Aggregated: Displays four metric summary cards for users, parents, children, and pairings.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertsPan: Shows a child's daily usage status, limit alerts, and a request-more-time form.
Shows a parent's view of a child's usage relative to the daily limit with summary alerts.
frontend/src/components/audit/AuditLogTa: Fetches and displays sortable audit log entries with action labels, executor, and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and admin gate reset.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for new users to enter name and choose parent or child role before saving profile.
frontend/src/components/child/ActivityHi: Lists a child's activity history in a table with sorting, optional transparency label, and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/child/ChildCheck: Provides child activity and location check-in forms with consent checks and submission handlers using mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/child/ConsentNot: Displays a consent transparency notice tailored to activity, location, or pairing actions.
frontend/src/components/child/LocationHi: Fetches and displays a sortable list of child-submitted locations with optional transparency labeling.
frontend/src/components/filters/ContentF: Allows parents to configure content filter categories, allowlists, and blocklists and save them via update mutations.
Shows a read-only view of a child's configured content filter, including categories and lists.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSel: Dropdown control for switching application languages using the i18n system.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Renders the app footer with policy access, branding, and external caffeine.ai link.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Displays app header with logo, user role, theme toggle, language selector, and transparency access.
frontend/src/components/parent/ActivityV: Shows a transparency notice and the child's activity history list for parents.
frontend/src/components/parent/ChildSumm: Summarizes a child's recent activity and location stats in a selectable card.
frontend/src/components/parent/LocationV: Shows a transparency notice and the child's location history list for parents.
frontend/src/components/parent/PairingSe: UI for generating and copying a mock pairing code with warnings and helper text.
frontend/src/components/schedule/Schedul: Schedule editor allowing parents to set daily limits and manage allowed time windows for a child.
Read-only view showing a child’s daily limit and allowed time windows.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminGate.ts: Session-based flag tracking whether the admin gate has been passed.
frontend/src/hooks/useI18n.ts: Provides access to the i18n context hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity login, stored identities, and provides authentication context to components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for profiles, schedules, children, activities, and locations.
frontend/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx: Provides language state, persistence, and translation lookup with parameter replacement.
frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: Exports supported locales and translation dictionaries for i18n.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/en.ts: English translation dictionary containing UI text, labels, and policy descriptions for the app.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/pt-BR.ts: Brazilian Portuguese translation dictionary mirroring the English keys for all UI and policy text.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and base styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry point initializing QueryClient, Internet Identity provider, and rendering the App.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard showing users, parent‑child links, and aggregated metrics using tabs and translation keys.
frontend/src/pages/child/ChildHome.tsx: Child home page showing welcome info, supervision notices, and tabs for check-ins, history, schedule, filters, and alerts.
frontend/src/pages/parent/ParentDashboar: Parent dashboard page showing child summaries, details tabs, and setup flow when no children are linked.
Component rendering the transparency and policies modal using translated text and UI sections.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters, including hash routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, typography, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing translation-related features, issues, and pending requests for full pt-BR coverage.
